arxiv-1507-02646.creator: Aki Vehtari aki.vehtari@aalto.fi, Daniel Simpson dan@normalcomputing.ai, Andrew Gelman gelman@stat.columbia.edu, Yuling Yao yyao@flatironinstitute.org, Jonah Gabry jgabry@gmail.com

arxiv-2110-06508.title: Efficiency in the Serverless Cloud Paradigm: A Survey on the Reusing and Approximation Aspects
arxiv-2110-06508.creator: Chavit Denninnart, Thanawat Chanikaphon, Mohsen Amini Salehi
arxiv-2110-06508.description: Abstract Serverless computing along with Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) is forming a new computing paradigm that is anticipated to found the next generation of cloud systems. The popularity of this paradigm is due to offering a highly transparent infrastructure that enables user applications to scale in the granularity of their functions.

arxiv-2111-08675.title: Atomic Floquet Physics Revealed by Free Electrons
arxiv-2111-08675.creator: Eduardo Arqué López, Valerio Di Giulio, F. Javier García de Abajo
arxiv-2111-08675.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Eduardo Arqué López, Valerio Di Giulio, F. Javier García de Abajo. We theoretically investigate the ability of free electrons to yield information on the nonlinear Floquet dynamics of atomic systems subject to intense external illumination.

arxiv-2201-06350.creator: Nanna Zhou Hagström, Michael Schneider, Nico Kerber, Alexander Yaroslavtsev, Erick Burgos Parra, Marijan Beg, Martin Lang, Christian M. arxiv-2201-06350.description: Abstract The advent of X-ray free-electron lasers (XFELs) has revolutionized fundamental science, from atomic to condensed matter physics, from chemistry to biology, giving researchers access to X-rays with unprecedented brightness, coherence, and pulse duration. All XFEL facilities built until recently provided X-ray pulses at a relatively low repetition rate, with limited data statistics.

arxiv-2311-08149.title: Modeling Complex Disease Trajectories using Deep Generative Models with Semi-Supervised Latent Processes These authors contributed equally. cecileclaire.trottet@uzh.ch, manuel.schuerch@uzh.ch
arxiv-2311-08149.creator: Cécile Trottet, Manuel Schürch, Ahmed Allam, Imon Barua, Liubov Petelytska, Oliver Distler, Anna-Maria Hoffmann-Vold, Michael Krauthammer, the EUSTAR collaborators
arxiv-2311-08149.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a deep generative time series approach using latent temporal processes for modeling and holistically analyzing complex disease trajectories. We aim to find meaningful temporal latent representations of an underlying generative process that explain the observed disease trajectories in an interpretable and comprehensive way.

arxiv-2412-19693.title: Wannier states and spin supersolid physics in the triangular antiferromagnet K 2 Co(SeO 3 ) 2
arxiv-2412-19693.creator: M. Zhu, Leandro M. Chinellato, V. Romerio, N. Murai, S. Ohira-Kawamura, Christian Balz, Z. Yan, S. Gvasaliya, Yasuyuki Kato, C. D. Batista, A. Zheludev
arxiv-2412-19693.description: Abstract We combine ultra-high-resolution inelastic neutron scattering and quantum Monte Carlo simulations to study thermodynamics and spin excitations in the spin-supersolid phase of the triangular lattice XXZ antiferromagnet K 2 Co(SeO 3 ) 2 under zero and non-zero magnetic field.

arxiv-2501-04562.title: Spherical Double K-Means: a co-clustering approach for text data analysis
arxiv-2501-04562.creator: Ilaria Bombelli, Domenica Fioredistella Iezzi, Emiliano Seri, Maurizio Vichi
arxiv-2501-04562.description: Abstract In text analysis, Spherical K-means (SKM) is a specialized k-means clustering algorithm widely utilized for grouping documents represented in high-dimensional, sparse term-document matrices, often normalized using techniques like TF-IDF. Researchers frequently seek to cluster not only documents but also the terms associated with them into coherent groups.

arxiv-2504-16285.title: Environmental Dependence of X-Ray Emission From The Least Massive Galaxies 2026 Environmental Dependence of X-Ray Emission From The Least Massive Galaxies – References
arxiv-2504-16285.creator: Marko Mićić, Xinyu Dai, Nick Shumate, Khoa Nguyen Tran, Heechan Yuk
arxiv-2504-16285.description: Abstract The low-mass end of low-mass galaxies is largely unexplored in AGN studies, but it is essential for extending our understanding of the black hole-galaxy coevolution. We surveyed the 3D-HST catalog and collected a sample of 546 dwarf galaxies with stellar masses log(M ∗ / M ⊙ M_{\odot} ) < < 8.7, residing in the GOODS-South deep field.

arxiv-2505-08940.title: NEURIPS2024 Ariel Data Challenge: Characterization of Exoplanetary Atmospheres Using a Data-Centric Approach
arxiv-2505-08940.creator: Jérémie BLANCHARD, Lisa CASINO, Jordan GIERSCHENDORF
arxiv-2505-08940.description: Abstract The characterization of exoplanetary atmospheres through spectral analysis is a complex challenge. The NeurIPS 2024 Ariel Data Challenge [ 1 ] , in collaboration with the European Space Agency’s (ESA) Ariel mission [ 2 ] , provided an opportunity to explore machine learning techniques for extracting atmospheric compositions from simulated spectral data.

arxiv-2507-11452.title: On the paper “Optimal dual frames of probabilistic erasures" Journal: IEEE Access
arxiv-2507-11452.creator: Shankhadeep Mondal, Ram Narayan Mohapatra
arxiv-2507-11452.description: Abstract In the paper “Optimal Dual Frames for Probabilistic Erasures” [ 8 ] , the authors have given conditions under which the canonical dual is claimed to be the unique probability optimal dual for 1 − 1- erasure reconstruction. In this paper, we demonstrate via counterexamples that the conditions provided are not sufficient to guarantee uniqueness.

pmc-11291646.title: Semi-autonomous touch method merging robot’s autonomous touch and user-operated touch for improving user experience in robot touch
pmc-11291646.creator: Ryoma Mitsuoka, Tomonori Kubota, Satoshi Sato, Kohei Ogawa
pmc-11291646.description: The demand for therapeutic robots to alleviate mental health problems is growing. Studies have shown that people’s mental health improves when they are touched. Consequently, therapeutic robots are designed to alleviate stress through robot’s autonomous touch. However, robot’s autonomous touch can sometimes cause discomfort to recipients.

pmc-11536590.title: Cisplatin-encapsulated TRAIL-engineered exosomes from human chorion-derived MSCs for targeted cervical cancer therapy
pmc-11536590.creator: Miaomiao Ye, Tingxian Liu, Liqing Miao, Huihui Ji, Zhihui Xu, Huihui Wang, Jian’an Zhang, Xueqiong Zhu
pmc-11536590.description: BackgroundCisplatin (DDP) is an efficacious and widely applied chemotherapeutic drug for cervical cancer patients who are diagnosed as metastatic and inoperable, or desiring fertility preservation. Tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-related apoptosis inducing ligand (TRAIL) selectively triggers cancer cells apoptosis by binding to cognate death receptors (DR4 and DR5).

pmc-12438545.title: Eating Disorders: Prevalence of Bulimia Nervosa Among Tunisian Military Nursing Students
pmc-12438545.creator: Y Ben Othmene, S Bejaoui, W Kabtni, A Baatout, S Eddif, I Gafsi, H Kefi, A Oumaya
pmc-12438545.description: IntroductionEating disorders are life-threatening. They affect both physical and mental well-being, specially among young adults in high-stress environments such as military training.Bulimia Nervosa (BN) is characterized by binge eating and inappropriate compensatory behavior to control weight with potentially dangerous sequelae.Early recognition is essential to optimise treatment management.

pmc-12525148.title: Duration of fixed appliance treatment using 0.018-inch slot versus 0.022-inch slot brackets: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12525148.creator: Mumen Z Rizk, Hisham Mohammed, John Samy, Grant McIntyre, David Bearn
pmc-12525148.description: BackgroundThe duration of fixed orthodontic appliance treatment is a major concern for both patients and clinicians. A lengthy treatment increases the likelihood of iatrogenic effects and burdens patient compliance.ObjectivesThe primary aim of this review is to compare the duration of orthodontic treatment between 0.018-inch and 0.022-inch slot brackets.

pmc-12688917.title: Incidence and mortality trend of liver cancer in Iran from 1990 to 2021: an epidemiological investigation using the Global Burden of Disease study
pmc-12688917.creator: Onika Kazi, Shokoufeh Hamidzadeh, Amirhossein Ghaseminejad-Raeini, Alireza Azarboo, Amirhossein Shirinezhad
pmc-12688917.description: Background:The burden of liver cancer across the world is one of the most concerning. Iran, as a developing country, lacks a comprehensive review of liver cancer burden in recent years. This study aimed to evaluate the changing burden of liver cancer in Iran from 1990 to 2021.Methods:Data were extracted from the Global Burden of Disease study.

pmc-12745250.title: Comparative analysis of sitting pressures in individuals with spinal cord injury: static vs. dynamic air cushions
pmc-12745250.creator: Irene Corral-López, Adrià Marco-Ahulló, César Rubio-Belmonte, Xurxo Segura-Navarro, Juan Manuel Pozo-Alegre, Lluïsa Montesinos-Magraner
pmc-12745250.description: BackgroundPressure injuries (PIs) significantly affect the health and social participation of individuals with spinal cord injury (SCI). Anti-decubitus cushions help prevent these injuries by distributing weight and reducing peak pressures. Evidence supports air cushions as the most effective solution for pressure relief during sitting.

pmc-12767786.title: Optimizing the sensitivity of detection of respiratory syncytial virus infections in longitudinal studies using the combination of weekly sample testing and biannual serology
pmc-12767786.creator: Shannon C Conrey, Daniel C Payne, Maria Deza Leon, Monica Epperson, Melissa M Coughlin, Allison R Burrell, Claire P Mattison, Rachel M Burke, Julia M Baker, Natalie J Thornburg, Meredith L McMorrow, Mary Allen Staat, Ardythe L Morrow
pmc-12767786.description: Cohort studies are often challenged by incomplete adherence to sampling regimens, limiting the full capture of disease burden. We describe the detection of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections achieved in a birth cohort using a combination of weekly nasal sample testing and serology.

pmc-12821961.title: Exploring medical students’ attitudes and perceptions toward artificial intelligence in medicine in Shandong Province, China
pmc-12821961.creator: Mingchan Liu, Yi Cheng, Shu Li, Shanshan Wang, Feng Du, Xiaonan Wei, Zhiying Ai, Siyuan Yan
pmc-12821961.description: BackgroundThe integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into medical education has transformative potential, yet understanding medical students’ attitudes toward AI remains critical for its effective implementation. This study investigates the attitudes, perceptions, and the factors influencing them among medical students in Shandong, China, toward AI in education.

pmc-13007018.title: Predictive Quantum Vibrational Spectra through Active Learning 4G-NNPs
pmc-13007018.creator: Md Omar Faruque, Dil K. Limbu, Nathan London, Mohammad R. Momeni
pmc-13007018.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Predictive simulation of vibrational spectra of complex condensed-phase and interface systems with thousands of degrees of freedom has long been a challenging task of modern condensed matter theory. In this work, fourth-generation high-dimensional committee neural network potentials (4G-HDCNNPs) are developed using active learning and query-by-committee, and introduced to the essential nuclear quantum effects (NQEs) as well as conformational entropy and anharmonicities from path integral (PI) molecular dynamics simulations.
